therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: dual VEGFR2/EGFR/RET inhibition combined with proteasome inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: angiogenesis inhibition and protein degradation disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: adults with locally advanced or metastatic medullary thyroid cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: maximum tolerated dose (Phase I) and tumor response (Phase II)

results.effect_size: Phase I MTD: vandetanib 300 mg daily, bortezomib 1.3 mg/m²; Phase II: 0 responses in combination arm
results.target_engagement_evidence: vandetanib increased bortezomib Cmax/D from 0.98 to 1.92 ng/mL/mg (p=0.019)
biomarker_changes: calcitonin partial response in 5/16 Phase I patients
CEA partial response in 2/14 Phase I patients
subgroup_findings: Phase I partial response rate: 6/21 patients

dose_info.schedule: vandetanib daily, bortezomib days 1, 4, 8, 11 every 28 days

context.indication: locally advanced or metastatic medullary thyroid cancer
context.investigator_commentary: Terminated due to slow accrual, primary endpoint reached & investigator left NIH.
